title: Community tool library — connected architecture exercise

scope.name: Community tool lending service
scope.boundary: A sociotechnical service for reservation coordination, steward work, records, member communication and return-to-availability decisions. Membership eligibility remains the external registry decision; repair methods and provider decisions remain external. Logical components below are candidate responsibilities, not selected software or organisations.
included: Requests, candidate selection and wait-list dispositions
Concurrent eligibility and condition contributions, including negative outcomes
Ready notice, confirmed delivery, hold interval and expiry/extension
Identified-tool custody transfer and return receipt
Condition assessment, quarantine, repair response, reassessment and release
Inventory/request state, source constraints, unresolved sizing and planned checks
excluded: Software, lockers, organisation structure and communications technology selection
scope.phase: Concept operational and system analysis with candidate logical allocations
scope.decision: Agree authority, handover evidence, admission/release conditions and information responsibilities before selecting implementation.

actors.label: Member
actors.description: Requests and collects a tool; accepts loan terms and receipt.

actors.label: Volunteer steward
actors.description: Handles tools, confirms receipt and assesses condition.

actors.label: Duty coordinator
actors.description: Owns exceptions, extensions, repair requests and quarantine release decisions.

actors.label: External membership registry
actors.description: Sole authority for the membership eligibility decision.

actors.label: External repair provider
actors.description: Reports completed work and remaining defects; cannot release tools for lending.

operationalActivities.label: Request and accept a tool loan
operationalActivities.description: Express the need, select wait-list/closure and accept a specific loan.

operationalActivities.label: Coordinate reservations and exceptions
operationalActivities.description: Select a candidate, keep unresolved cases accountable and govern reservation disposition.

operationalActivities.label: Decide membership eligibility
operationalActivities.description: Return identified eligible, ineligible or unavailable decision.

operationalActivities.label: Assess identified-tool condition
operationalActivities.description: Inspect candidate, return or repaired tool and retain fit/unfit evidence.

operationalActivities.label: Confirm tool handover and return
operationalActivities.description: Confirm matched collection, terms/receipt and physical returned-tool receipt.

operationalActivities.label: Report repair outcome
operationalActivities.description: Supply completed work and known remaining defects for reassessment.

operationalActivities.label: Maintain accountable service information
operationalActivities.description: Make current request, inventory, custody and exception information available.

logicalComponents.label: Reservation coordination
logicalComponents.description: Own request, candidate and eligibility coordination without taking registry decision authority.

logicalComponents.label: Condition assessment
logicalComponents.description: Own steward inspection evidence and matching of its identified tool.

logicalComponents.label: Member communication
logicalComponents.description: Own notice content, confirmation evidence and current-outcome communication.

logicalComponents.label: Custody handover
logicalComponents.description: Own matching, terms/receipt acceptance and ordered custody transfer.

logicalComponents.label: Condition recovery
logicalComponents.description: Own quarantine, external repair coordination and authorised release or retirement.

logicalComponents.label: Service state and inventory
logicalComponents.description: Own identified-tool state, custody linkage, hold timing and availability invariant.

functions.label: Capture the request
functions.description: Retain member, category and desired collection period.

functions.label: Select an available identified candidate
functions.description: Use the current inventory state; do not reserve inventory for a wait-list.

functions.label: Dispose of an unfilled request
functions.description: Offer wait-list or closure at the member choice without a tool reservation.

functions.label: Establish the preparation case
functions.description: Retain the selected member/tool identifiers before the two independent preparation contributions.

functions.label: Obtain the registry decision
functions.description: Request and retain the external decision and identifiers; do not manufacture a positive decision.

functions.label: Inspect the candidate tool
functions.description: Retain the steward fit/unfit finding for the selected identified tool.

functions.label: Assess preparation contributions
functions.description: Match member/tool evidence and distinguish eligible-and-fit, unavailable, ineligible and unfit cases.

functions.label: Prepare the ready reservation
functions.description: Commit the eligible member/fit identified tool reservation; exclude that tool from available offers.

functions.label: Deliver the ready notice
functions.description: Provide tool, location and hold deadline; retain delivery outcome separately from queueing. Deadline/acknowledgement coordination needs agreement.

functions.label: Record confirmed notice delivery
functions.description: Retain actual confirmed delivery time; missing confirmation remains pending-notification.

functions.label: Govern the confirmed hold interval
functions.description: Bind the minimum hold to confirmed delivery time; withdrawal/new fault exceptions remain separate.

functions.label: Resolve expiry, withdrawal or extension
functions.description: Coordinator returns a still-fit tool after expiry or records the extension reason; withdrawal is a separate release cause.

functions.label: Match the collection case
functions.description: Steward checks member and allocated tool against the reservation.

functions.label: Capture terms and identified-tool receipt acceptance
functions.description: Record member acceptance; presentation or readiness alone is insufficient.

functions.label: Record custody transfer to member
functions.description: Commit library-to-member custody only after matching and acceptance evidence.

functions.label: Record the tool on loan
functions.description: Update on-loan state after the custody transfer record.

functions.label: Confirm returned-tool receipt
functions.description: Steward receives the identified tool and records library custody; a member report alone is insufficient.

functions.label: Assess returned-tool condition
functions.description: Keep received tool unavailable pending fit/unfit assessment.

functions.label: Quarantine an unfit tool
functions.description: Retain identity, condition and unavailability.

functions.label: Coordinate the repair request
functions.description: Coordinator decides whether to request external repair and retains tool/defect context.

functions.label: Receive the repair report
functions.description: Retain completed work and remaining defects; the report grants no lending release.

functions.label: Reassess after repair
functions.description: Steward reassesses the identified tool before any quarantine release.

functions.label: Release a fit tool for availability
functions.description: Apply the accountable availability decision; quarantine release requires the steward fit finding and coordinator decision.

functions.label: Decide rework or retirement
functions.description: Coordinator retains quarantine for remaining defects and chooses a separate repair attempt or retirement.

functions.label: Coordinate an unresolved case
functions.description: Keep pending, refusal, contact, handover and condition exceptions with an accountable coordinator.

functions.label: Maintain custody, condition and availability state
functions.description: Maintain tool identity, custody, condition, reservation linkage and unresolved exceptions; prevent available offers in excluded states.

functions.label: Communicate the current request outcome
functions.description: Provide pending, ready, refused, extended or closed outcomes without implying loan or repair success.

requirements.label: Retain registry decision authority
requirements.description: Retain registry member/decision identity and eligible, ineligible or unavailable outcome; neither service nor volunteer creates a positive decision.
requirements.subject: F_ELIG
requirements.criterion: Retain registry member/decision identity and eligible, ineligible or unavailable outcome; neither service nor volunteer creates a positive decision.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the source condition, authority and observable outcome.

requirements.label: Keep wait-list separate from reservation
requirements.description: Offer wait-list or closure at member choice without a reservation or decrease of available inventory.
requirements.subject: F_NO_CAND
requirements.criterion: Offer wait-list or closure at member choice without a reservation or decrease of available inventory.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the source condition, authority and observable outcome.

requirements.label: Require both matching preparation contributions
requirements.description: The selected member is eligible and selected tool fit, with matching decision/inspection identities; unavailable remains pending, ineligible remains accountable, unfit is quarantined.
requirements.subject: F_ASSESS
requirements.criterion: The selected member is eligible and selected tool fit, with matching decision/inspection identities; unavailable remains pending, ineligible remains accountable, unfit is quarantined.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the source condition, authority and observable outcome.

requirements.label: Provide the ready notice content
requirements.description: Identify the ready tool, collection location and hold deadline; retain queueing and confirmed delivery as different events.
requirements.subject: F_NOTICE
requirements.criterion: Identify the ready tool, collection location and hold deadline; retain queueing and confirmed delivery as different events.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the source condition, authority and observable outcome.

requirements.label: Maintain at least two confirmed-delivery hours
requirements.description: Hold the ready reservation for at least two hours measured from confirmed notice delivery, not queued-notice time.
requirements.subject: F_HOLD
requirements.condition: After confirmed delivery unless member withdraws or a new tool fault is discovered
requirements.criterion: Hold the ready reservation for at least two hours measured from confirmed notice delivery, not queued-notice time.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the source condition, authority and observable outcome.

requirements.label: Retain pending notification without confirmation
requirements.description: Keep pending-notification and coordinator contact resolution; do not expire using an assumed delivery time.

requirements.criterion: Keep pending-notification and coordinator contact resolution; do not expire using an assumed delivery time.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the source condition, authority and observable outcome.

requirements.label: Record the coordinator expiry/extension decision
requirements.description: Only return a still-fit tool to available or extend with a recorded coordinator reason; retain withdrawal and fault as distinct causes.

requirements.criterion: Require member/tool matching, accepted loan terms and receipt of the identified tool; record library-to-member custody then on-loan state. Ready notice, eligibility or presentation alone cannot complete transfer.
requirements.rationale: Preserve the source condition, authority and observable outcome.

requirements.label: Require actual returned-tool receipt

requirements.criterion: Record steward-confirmed identified receipt and library custody; member return report alone is insufficient.

requirements.label: Reassess repair without implied release

verificationCases.label: Review maintain at least two confirmed-delivery hours
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Use queued, confirmed, absent-confirmation, withdrawal and new-fault cases with a controlled time basis.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Hold the ready reservation for at least two hours measured from confirmed notice delivery, not queued-notice time.

verificationCases.label: Review retain pending notification without confirmation
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Suppress confirmation and inspect state and absence of assumed-time expiry.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Keep pending-notification and coordinator contact resolution; do not expire using an assumed delivery time.

verificationCases.label: Review record the coordinator expiry/extension decision
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Walk expiry, reasoned extension and new-fault cases.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Only return a still-fit tool to available or extend with a recorded coordinator reason; retain withdrawal and fault as distinct causes.

verificationCases.label: Review complete matched and accepted custody handover
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Try mismatch, missing terms, missing receipt and notice-only cases; compare custody/state event order.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Require member/tool matching, accepted loan terms and receipt of the identified tool; record library-to-member custody then on-loan state. Ready notice, eligibility or presentation alone cannot complete transfer.

verificationCases.label: Review require actual returned-tool receipt
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Compare a member-only report with witnessed steward receipt.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Record steward-confirmed identified receipt and library custody; member return report alone is insufficient.

verificationCases.label: Review reassess repair without implied release
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Use completed-with-defects report followed by fit and unfit reassessment cases.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Steward reassesses condition; completion wording or unresolved defects cannot establish fit or lending availability.

verificationCases.label: Review preserve quarantine release authority
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Inspect release authority and block provider-only completion.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Require steward fit assessment and coordinator release decision; remaining defects retain quarantine and require a separate rework/retirement decision.

verificationCases.label: Review prevent contradictory available offers
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Query available offers in each excluded state and after a valid release.
verificationCases.expectedResult: An identified tool is not offered as available while reserved, on loan, awaiting returned-tool assessment or quarantined.

verificationCases.label: Review retain decision-relevant service information
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Inspect a full lifecycle record and deliberately omit each required relation.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Retain tool identity, custody, condition, reservation linkage and unresolved exceptions for steward/coordinator work.

verificationCases.label: Review communicate current request disposition
verificationCases.description: Planned evidence activity; no executed result.
verificationCases.setup: Compare communicated outcome with current custody, condition and exception state.
verificationCases.expectedResult: Communicate current pending, ready, refused, extended or closed outcome without inferring loan/repair success from notification.

insights.label: Readiness depends on two different authorities
insights.description: Eligibility and condition may run concurrently; matching both contributions is the admission boundary.
insights.observation: Registry and steward evidence have different subjects and owners.
insights.implication: A shared readiness record needs both identities; success of either contribution alone cannot admit.

insights.label: Delivery confirmation determines the hold origin
insights.description: Queueing a notice cannot start the required minimum hold.
insights.observation: The hold origin is a confirmed delivery event whose mechanism is unresolved.
insights.implication: Agree confirmation and deadline reconciliation before specifying notification timing behavior.

insights.label: Repair completion and lending release are separate
insights.description: Provider evidence feeds a steward reassessment and coordinator release decision.
insights.observation: Remaining defects can coexist with a completed-work report.
insights.implication: Do not wire repair completion directly to available inventory.
